# Variable `KERNEL_STRIP`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Allows to specific which `strip` command to use to strip the kernel binary, typically either GNU binutils `strip` or `llvm-strip`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-KERNEL_STRIP
